method: Same-agent English/Marathi close reading; exact structural and projected-formula comparison; and reconstruction of the partial-isomorphism argument from the two sequence extensions through downward Löwenheim--Skolem. No independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: Compactness and downward Löwenheim--Skolem for abstract logics, and the proof that partial isomorphism implies L-elementary equivalence.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Compactness says every finitely satisfiable set of abstract sentences is satisfiable; downward Löwenheim--Skolem says every satisfiable set has an enumerable model. Under normality and the latter property, partially isomorphic structures are L-elementarily equivalent.
samples.checks: The two definitions, enumerability conclusion, algebraic character of partial isomorphism and theorem hypotheses are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Assume partially isomorphic M and N disagree on E. Form M-star and N-star by adjoining their finite-sequence domains and concatenation relations, then place both in an ambient structure A with a relation coding the back-and-forth partial isomorphisms.
samples.checks: Finite-language dependence, downward closure of the partial-isomorphism set, both ternary relations, predicate arities, starred domains, the ambient figure and all substructure inclusions are retained. OLFOL-046 supplies distinct notation for the ambient structure and repairs the malformed N-star domain.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Relativization yields an abstract sentence D1 expressing opposite E-values on the two substructures, while a first-order sentence D2 expresses their internal partial isomorphism. Downward Löwenheim--Skolem yields a countable ambient A0 with countable partially isomorphic M0 and N0, which are isomorphic and hence cannot disagree on E.
samples.checks: D1 and D2 retain their distinct logical classes, both satisfaction polarities and the contradiction through isomorphism. OLFOL-047 and OLFOL-048 repair the source's sentence-class and repeated-M0 errors.

source_observations: OLFOL-046 separates the ambient A from its M and N substructures and regularizes the N-star domain notation.
OLFOL-047 records that relativized D1 is an L-sentence, whereas D2 is first-order.
OLFOL-048 distinguishes the enumerable ambient A0 from its M0 and N0 substructures.
The target-to-source QA projections reconstruct only the frozen symbols and do not weaken the semantic checks.
limitations: No independent human or native-speaker review has been performed.
The source compresses the first-order coding of the internal partial-isomorphism relation; the translation does not add a separate coding lemma.
No TeX reader build was run for this source-only unit checkpoint.
